vacancies.title: Front of House
vacancies.summary: The first person every visitor meets, and the one who keeps the diary honest.
duties: Welcome walk-ins and find them a time when the rooms are full
Answer WhatsApp with the real diary open, so what we promise is what we have
Keep the WhatsApp diary and Treatwell saying the same thing
Take calls, card and cash payments, and issue gift vouchers
Note what a client asked for, including when they want the same therapist again
essential: No beauty qualification needed
English good enough to talk with clients and write replies
Comfortable with a booking system on screen
The right to work in the UK
desirable: A second language that matches our clients
Experience of a busy service counter
Enough of a feel for the menu to suggest a treatment

vacancies.title: Spa Assistant
vacancies.summary: The role that gives every therapist their time back, and the fastest way into the trade here.
duties: Wash, fold and keep the linen moving
Turn a room around between clients
Switch the sauna on 45 minutes ahead
Keep the rooms stocked
Clean and lay out tools on schedule
Look after the pedicure row and the foot spas
essential: No beauty qualification needed
Able to follow a hygiene routine to the letter
The right to work in the UK
desirable: An infection control certificate
Experience in a spa or a hotel

vacancies.title: Massage Therapist
vacancies.summary: Fifteen treatments on the menu, from a 15-minute foot massage to two hours of deep tissue.
duties: Work the massage menu: Thai, deep tissue, Swedish, aromatherapy, hot stone, sports, foot and head
Ask about aches and history before every treatment, every time
Adjust pressure to what the client tells you, not to what the booking says
Turn your own room around and change the linen
essential: A body massage qualification with anatomy and physiology among its units — we ask for the units, not only the certificate name
At Level 3 for the treatments that need it
Register as a therapist with Islington Council before starting — the council asks for your qualifications unit by unit, and allows at least 21 days
The right to work in the UK
desirable: Thai technique certified by a school
Deep tissue or sports as separate units
Pregnancy massage

vacancies.title: Beauty Therapist
vacancies.summary: Facials, waxing and brow and lash work — three lines that run side by side here.
duties: Seven facials, 60 to 95 minutes
Waxing across 19 options, including intimate waxing in a closed room
Threading, brow and lash tinting, lash perming
Five body treatments
Write down for the client what was used on them
essential: A beauty therapy qualification covering facials and waxing, with the units to show for each
Level 3 where the treatment calls for it, including intimate waxing
Register as a therapist with Islington Council before starting — the council asks for your qualifications unit by unit, and allows at least 21 days
The right to work in the UK
desirable: Facial electrotherapy units — galvanic, faradic, microcurrent — because the menu includes a non-surgical face lift facial
Intimate waxing as a separate unit

vacancies.title: Nail Technician
vacancies.summary: Thirty-three treatments and the shortest turnarounds in the shop.
duties: Manicures and pedicures, classic and spa, with polish or UV gel
Acrylic and fibre gel extensions, infills and removals
Keep tools and the pedicure row clean between clients
essential: Manicure and pedicure qualifications
A separate nail extensions qualification at Level 3
Register as a therapist with Islington Council before starting — the council asks for your qualifications unit by unit, and allows at least 21 days
The right to work in the UK
desirable: Both acrylic and fibre gel
An eye for finish that holds up in a photograph

vacancies.title: Lash Technician
vacancies.summary: The line we most want a second pair of hands on.
duties: Classic, hybrid and Russian volume extensions, around an hour
Infills at 30 to 45 minutes, removals at 20
Lash lifting and tinting
Patch test and consultation before any first set
essential: An eyelash extensions qualification at Level 3, with the units to show
Register as a therapist with Islington Council before starting — the council asks for your qualifications unit by unit, and allows at least 21 days
The right to work in the UK
desirable: Russian volume as a unit of its own, separate from classic
Lash lifting

vacancies.title: Hair Stylist
vacancies.summary: Sixteen treatments, from a blow dry to six hours of Japanese straightening.

Keratin and Japanese straightening
Blow dry and styling
Hair spa treatments
Bookings run from 30 minutes to six hours
essential: A hairdressing qualification
The right to work in the UK
desirable: Japanese straightening and keratin, the longest and most exacting work on the menu
The Asian cutting technique the shop is known for

No-needle mesotherapy
Microblading and semi-permanent make-up
Laser tattoo removal
Consultation and patch test before every first appointment

vacancies.title: Salon Coordinator
vacancies.summary: The role that keeps the paperwork ahead of the shop rather than behind it.

Keep the menu and prices right on Treatwell
Order stock and keep count
Hold the staff file: right to work, qualifications, council registrations
Track when the premises licence comes up for renewal

Orderly with paperwork, because this role is the paperwork
The right to work in the UK
desirable: Salon or clinic administration
A feel for compliance records

Keep quality honest on the floor
Assess new therapists before they take on the Taitam-D Signature
Decide when a client should see a doctor instead

Experience leading a team
